{{Quote|Every profession penalizes those who employ inadequately trained personnel. Only in the military are those penalties so ruinous and final.|Thull Yularen|<ref name="EGW" />}}
'''Thull Yularen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later taught at the [[Anaxes Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. He believed that military [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] should aspire for perfection and be sufficiently trained. Yularen's service became an inspiration for his son, [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf]], who later had an extensive military career of his own.

==Biography==
[[File:WullfYularen-ANH.png|thumb|right|200px|Thull was the father of Wullf Yularen.]]
Thull Yularen was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="EGW" /> whose [[Yularen family|family]], which [[Coruscanti/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], possessed sizable influence in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Yularen served as a member of the Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], working in the organization for a substantial amount of [[Time/Legends|time]]. After leaving the Judicial Forces,<ref name="EGW" /> he established himself as a renowned [[Navy/Legends|naval]] instructor<ref name="OEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> at the [[Anaxes Citadel]] on the planet [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].<ref name="EGW" />

Yularen's son, [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf]], showed an early interest in his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] career. In their [[Yularen estate|estate]] in Anaxes's [[Sirpar Hills]], the elder Yularen imparted his knowledge to his son, answering Wullf's questions about historical [[Space warfare/Legends|naval engagements]] and the like. Wullf Yularen went on to serve a distinguished career that included stints as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and as an intelligence operative in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Republic's successor state.<ref name="EGW" />

==Personality and traits==
As an instructor, Yularen expected the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] under his charge to achieve perfection,<ref name="OEG" /> knowing that military personnel who lacked sufficient training were destined to fail in the line of duty. He was regarded as a legend for his service in the Judicial Forces and on Anaxes.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Thull Yularen, albeit unnamed, was first mentioned in Wullf Yularen's biography in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="OEG" /> Fry later included the character&mdash;and identified him by name&mdash;in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book published in [[2012]].<ref name="EGW" /> Yularen originally had a larger role in the book; several sections cut from the final draft were attributed as [[in-universe]] writings of his.<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
